name: Editorial Dark
description: Moody editorial photography with dramatic dark tones
short_description: Keep the exact product from the input image completely unchanged - preserve its colors, shape, texture, and all visual characteristics. Only change the background to dark, moody tones and adjust lighting to dramatic low-key lighting. The product itself must remain identical to the input.
product_preservation_instruction: CRITICAL: The product must remain visually identical to the input image. Do not alter, reinterpret, or regenerate the product. Only modify the environment (background, lighting, shadows) around the unchanged product.

objects.description: The exact product from the input image, preserved as-is, dramatically lit against dark background
objects.relationship: Primary subject emerging from darkness with selective illumination
objects.shape_and_color: Muted, sophisticated colors with rich shadows and selective highlights
objects.texture: Dramatic surface details revealed through selective lighting
objects.appearance_details: Moody presentation with deep shadows, selective highlights creating mystery and sophistication

background_setting: Dark, moody background (black, deep charcoal, or dark navy) creating dramatic atmosphere and editorial sophistication

lighting.direction: single directional light from side or above, creating strong contrast
lighting.shadows: deep, dramatic shadows with high contrast and mystery
lighting.quality: hard, focused light creating chiaroscuro effect

photographic_characteristics.camera_angle: eye level or slightly low angle for dramatic perspective
photographic_characteristics.depth_of_field: moderate, product in sharp focus with dark background
photographic_characteristics.focus: sharp focus on product with dramatic falloff

aesthetics.composition: asymmetric, editorial composition with negative space and drama
aesthetics.color_scheme: dark, moody palette with muted colors and selective highlights
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: moody, dramatic, mysterious, sophisticated, editorial, luxurious

context: Editorial and luxury product photography for high-end magazines, fashion brands, and premium advertising campaigns
